To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

business and systems analysis is performed by a team of experts that is supported by the Enterprise Architecture team, that the project team and architecture team work in close collaboration, that the project is managed according to the architecture, and that the architecture is used to support project decisions.

the enterprise architect has a key role to play in the success of projects conforming to Enterprise Architecture, that the project manager has to be involved in the design of the project, that the project team needs to be trained in the architecture, that the project plan needs to be aligned with the architecture, that project deliverables need to conform to the architecture, that architecture compliance needs to be monitored, and that the enterprise architect needs to provide support to project teams.

enterprise architects and project members should: (1) jointly develop an Enterprise Architecture Roadmap, (2) jointly develop a Project Architecture Roadmap, and (3) jointly develop a project architecture plan.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to perform projects in a way that is in line with the enterprise architecture.
a specific type of projects that are required by Enterprise Architecture, and aims to contribute to the knowledge about how these projects should be conducted.
the question: “How can we perform business and systems analysis effectively in projects required to comply with architecture?”
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the best practices presented in this paper are not the best practices, but they are the best practices we have identified in our study.
the guidelines are a good idea and should be considered as a good practice in projects that are conforming to enterprise architecture.
the presented best practices are good ideas to consider when performing business and systems projects in a setting that requires conformance with Enterprise Architecture.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the best way to perform a project conforming to architecture is to perform the project according to architecture.
the best practices for business and systems analysis are similar for projects conforming to and projects not conforming to architecture, but that there are some specific differences.
the best practices we present are useful in projects conforming to Enterprise Architecture, and they can help project members to perform their tasks more efficiently.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the business analysis process in projects conforming to Enterprise Architecture is different from the process in projects that do not conform to architecture.
enterprise architects should take the lead in projects that are expected to conform to architecture.
business and systems analysis should be carried out in close collaboration with enterprise architects.
